verdict: The unique double-sealed M2047 attempt and result support a narrow component-cycle claim. Four exact VCS simulations use the first captured sample from each of four sealed ep34 sequences, layer 28, and token contexts 0..3. The same M2018 B4/G48/LRU4 parametric RTL and the same external interfaces, cache capacity, directed bank timing and backpressure functions are used on both axes; only the static token-major versus source-group-major schedule mode changes. Exact scoreboards, work conservation, stale and retired-identity replay attacks, two resets, legal post-reset service and signed/-128 directed recovery pass. Independently recomputed totals are 86,713 ordinary-LRU4 cycles versus 30,775 TSBG cycles, or 2.817644x, and 60,960 versus 18,336 scalar bank requests, or 69.921260% fewer. The exact M2018 and M803 source hashes also match M2030, which separately admits only a matched 3 ns TSMC-28 logic-only setup/area ablation with 0.0117568% TSBG logic-area overhead. These facts may be stated together with both scopes attached; they do not establish full-FC1, full-capture, same-area, macro-inclusive, hold-closed, real-weight, power, energy, or system performance.

fixed_selection_audit.rule: first captured sample of each sequence; layer 28; tokens 0..3

same_resource_axis_audit.only_mode_difference: SCHEDULE_MODE=0 token-major versus SCHEDULE_MODE=1 source-group-major static bitmap ordering and matching selected-row clear index

exactness_and_protocol_audit.descriptor_domain: captured {-1,0,+1} codewords; selected nonzeros are all +1
exactness_and_protocol_audit.directed_weight_domain: deterministic signed INT8 including -128; not captured model weights
exactness_and_protocol_audit.minus_128_recovery: direct base bridge +128 observation and exact commit scoreboards on both axes in the synthetic post-reset workload

P2: The four measured ep34 descriptor bundles contain zero negative codes. Negative source and INT8 -128 recovery are separately directed after the measured interval; do not describe the cycle workload as empirically bipolar.
The result covers four token contexts from one FC1 layer in four first samples, not all tokens, all FC1 layers, the full 40-sample capture, or the system.

M2047 reverse-pins the frozen fixture but not its builder, sealed sample_order.json, or layers.json. This independent review pins and rechecks those identities, but a successor production bundle should carry them directly.
M2030 is logic-only, pre-macro, ideal-clock and ZeroWireload; state arrays are standard cells and hold is diagnostic at -0.0164 ns. No macro, power, energy, same-area or paper-PPA claim follows.

permitted_wording: On a fixed four-sequence, first-sample, layer-28 four-token G48 microbenchmark using real ep34 activity masks, exact VCS execution of the same B4/LRU4 parametric RTL reduced component cycles from 86,713 to 30,775 (2.818x; 64.51% fewer) and scalar weight-bank requests from 60,960 to 18,336 (69.92% fewer) by changing token-major scheduling to source-group-major weight-row reuse. Both modes conserved the same rows, issues, products and commits and passed directed backpressure, replay, stale-response, reset-recovery and signed arithmetic checks. Separately, matched 3 ns TSMC-28 logic-only DC of the exact same M2018/M803 source measured 249,710 versus 249,740 um2 (0.0118% schedule-area overhead), with setup met on both modes; macros, hold closure, power and energy are excluded.
forbidden_wording: multiplication of M2047 cycle speedup by M2030 area or any other component speedup
recommended_next_gate: If a broader paper claim is needed, replay all tokens for at least the same four sequences and all relevant FC1 layers through an address-timed memory-inclusive model, preserve the ordinary-LRU4 same-port baseline, use real quantized weights for numerical end-to-end checking, and obtain macro-aware hold-closed power evidence. This review does not authorize or require another EDA/GPU run.
